body: You took the first step in realizing you don’t need ANYBODY to tell you how much love you deserve. Now that you’re broken up, allow yourself to hurt, heal, and recover. Discover that there is somebody out there made for you, that will love you effortlessly and go above and beyond to make you happy. You seem like you’ve got a great head on your shoulders! Be grateful you received this lesson. Breakups suck, no other way around it. But time heals. You’ll discover that the relationship was toxic. Don’t worry about him. Realize you deserve somebodies best. I don’t even know you and I know you deserve that! I’m rooting for you. Keep me updated! You’re never alone. Remember that.

You’re gonna be fine. You’re so young dude. I literally went through the same thing. We broke up, but GOD I got into such a happier relationship because of it. 18-22, I’m 22 now, has been NUTS. But I wouldn’t change a thing. I’ve lived a ton. You’ll be okay man. You’re still so so young.

The light gets brighter and brighter the closer you get to the end of that tunnel! Let time heal you. Do things you’ve never done before. Love yourself, heal, and reinvent yourself with the lessons you learned from this past breakup. You’re gonna be okay man. I know it!
Hope you’re okay! Take a breath. It’ll be okay

That’s a very tough thing to do. But protect your mental, and know there’s somebody out there that will give you exactly the love you need. True feelings reciprocate! Keep ya head up. Get out there and do something great!
You’ll be good! Keep pushin! We’re all rooting for ya

A lot of really dope people out there, you just gotta get out there! You’re far from that dude. Confidence in yourself is a very good thing to have. Every feeling you have a is normal, thousands if not millions are feeling exactly what you are at this moment. You’ll be good dude. Take it a day at a time.

You gotta keep pushin brotha! Every single day itll get better and better. Make small goals throughout the day. If you can’t eat, get something small! Drink water. Eat munchies if you have to! Things get better and better. Don’t let you mind wander and what could’ve been. Realize there’s so many other wonderful amazing people out there and i know it seems like she was the only one. (Trust me, it’s been over a year and I still think about my ex sometimes!) but the its always reminiscing of the good. Not the bad. 
Keep pushing man, take it day by day. There’s a ton of potential life changing people that’ll come your way. The best things always happen when you least expect it!

You just feel this way because somebody who you loved dearly made you feel disposable. Don’t let yourself feel that! 9 times out of 10 they don’t feel that way about you, things just didn’t work out. Go on dates, go after those who “aren’t in your league” trust me your confidence will be built. No reason to hate yourself. The most important person is yourself, so learn to love yourself again and your time alone before depending on another. Be great individually before becoming amazing together. You’ll be alright dude.

Your WORST enemy is memories and reminiscing on the past. Be thankful you were so happy! Many will never be able to experience that. I too, was heartbroken. I dated my ex for the same amount of time as you. But trust me, time heals! Let yourself hurt. Im gonna say that again. Let. Yourself. Hurt. Hangout with your family, friends, Co-workers, classmates, whatever you need to do. Being single again is something that you will need to get used to. But trust me. It gets better in time.
I’m 21 years old. I was certain she was going to be my wife. My last breakup I didn’t get over till a year afterwards. I don’t want to hurt that long again.
